svg.title: FFN Architecture Comparison - Classic ReLU vs Modern SwiGLU
svg.text: Feed-Forward Network - 2-layer ReLU (left) vs 3-layer SwiGLU gated variant (right)
Two linear projections with a single ReLU gate.
No multiplicative interaction - activation is static.
Gate stream modulates the up-proj stream element-wise.
Dynamic, learned gating - no static clipping.

g.text: Classic: 2 x d x 4d params (W₁, W₂)
SwiGLU: 3 x d x 4d params (W_gate, W_up, W_down) - hidden size often reduced to 2/3
